Some copies (obviously imported/distributed by Bellaphon in Germany) bear two little stickers with hand-written LC 4524, one on cover front and one on label side B.

The printed words on the bottom right of the inner bag ;
(var.5) R.S. 5-77, (var.6) R.S.10-77 and/or R.S. 12-77, (var7) R.S. 5-77

The horizontal line pattern at the upper left corner of the front jacket differs between (var.5&7) and (var.6).
(var.5&7) and (var.6) differ in the vertical line pattern at the upper left corner and the horizontal line pattern at the lower right corner on the back side og the jacket, and the printing position on the spine (the latter is shifted down by one character).
